caption: The drawing consists of several distinct scenes and text bands arranged within a rectangular border filled with stylized floral motifs, primarily in shades of pink, white, and blue against a black background. At the very top, four human figures stand beneath two trees and beside a small white table and a dog; two women in long dresses are on the left, a person in the center appears to be reading or singing from a book on a stand, and two more figures are on the right, one in white and the other in red. The next section features embroidered text in brown and black on a light background. Below this, a scene shows four people—one riding a white horse, one in a red dress in front of the horse, and two individuals walking, partially obscured by a large, centrally placed tree with dark green leaves and several birds. Beneath this, another group is shown: a woman in a pink dress, two men in green and brown outfits—one with a flute, and another pointing—and a small pond on the lower right with ducks floating on blue water and a black dog. More birds and animals are scattered throughout the landscape setting, mostly positioned in and around the trees and pond. At the very bottom is a rectangular cartouche with additional embroidered text in gold thread, flanked by symmetrical floral designs. The overall palette includes shades of green, pink, white, blue, yellow, and brown, with black backgrounds used to frame and define the sections and borders in the composition.
title: Sampler or Embroidered Picture
